screen.head: Brush head

app.name: Toothbrush
app.summary: Your electric toothbrush live: the zones you brush as a ring, the time, battery and pressure.
app.in_toothbrush_hint: The brush's main entity: Oral-B's toothbrush state, Sonicare's handle state, Laifen's status, Xiaomi's toothbrush. Its other entities are found from it; the settings name one when it has another name.
app.set_hint: Empty: found beside the toothbrush. An entity id, such as sensor.my_brush_sector, when yours has another name. The screen restarts once to follow it.
app.set_head_hint: Empty: found for Oral-B and Xiaomi. A Sonicare's brush head is a device of its own: its brush head wear, such as sensor.sonicare_brush_head_brush_head_wear.
app.opt_zones_hint: Auto shows 4 until the brush reports a fifth zone. Choose 6 for a brush that brushes in six from the start.
app.opt_routine_hint: How long a full session takes. It times the zones of a brush without a zone sensor.
app.opt_hold_hint: How many hours the ring shows how the last session went. 0 keeps it until the next one.
app.opt_head_hint: What the brush head entity counts.
